reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering books of power, relationship and food items, fish, crops, flooring, trash, eggs, and monster resources were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover probability effects, established names, planting behavior, humor, item gender, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

Book_WildSeeds_Description.source: Weeds have a greater chance to yield mixed seeds.
Book_WildSeeds_Description.translation: Buruienile au o șansă mai mare să dea Semințe amestecate.

Book_Woodcutting_Description.source: Felled trees have a 5% chance to yield double the wood.
Book_Woodcutting_Description.translation: Copacii doborâți au 5% șanse să dea de două ori mai mult lemn.

Bouquet_Description.source: A gift that shows your romantic interest.
Bouquet_Description.translation: Un cadou prin care îți arăți interesul romantic.

Bream_Description.source: A fairly common river fish that becomes active at night.
Bream_Description.translation: Un pește de râu destul de comun, care devine activ noaptea.

BrickFloor_Description.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to decorate your floors.
BrickFloor_Description.translation: Așaz-o pe sol pentru a crea poteci sau pentru a-ți decora podelele.

Broccoli_Name.preservationReason: Broccoli is the standard Romanian name of the vegetable and therefore remains identical to the English source.

Broccoli_Description.source: The flowering head of a broccoli plant. The tiny buds give it a unique texture.
Broccoli_Description.translation: Inflorescența plantei de broccoli. Bobocii minusculi îi dau o textură unică.

BroccoliSeeds_Description.source: Plant in the fall. Takes 8 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
BroccoliSeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le toamna. Ajung la maturitate în 8 zile și continuă să producă după prima recoltă.

BrokenCD_Description.source: It's a JojaNet 2.0 trial CD. They must've made a billion of these things.
BrokenCD_Description.translation: Este un CD cu versiunea de încercare JojaNet 2.0. Cei de la Joja trebuie să fi produs un miliard de exemplare.

BrokenGlasses_Description.source: It looks like someone lost their glasses. They're busted.
BrokenGlasses_Description.translation: Se pare că cineva și-a pierdut ochelarii. Sunt făcuți praf.

BrownEgg_Description.translation: Un ou maro obișnuit, de găină.

Bruschetta_Name.preservationReason: Bruschetta is the established Romanian culinary loanword and therefore remains identical to the English source.

Bruschetta_Description.source: Roasted tomatoes on a crisp white bread.
Bruschetta_Description.translation: Roșii coapte pe o felie crocantă de pâine albă.
